subject: pharmacology
title: Haematinics, growth factors and chelators

steps.tx: **Oral iron** (ferrous sulphate, fumarate; **empty stomach with vitamin C**, tea, antacids and calcium blocking, black stools expected, constipation managed) corrects deficiency with **Hb rising 2 g in 4 weeks**; failure reviews bleeding, compliance and malabsorption (hookworm, piles, menorrhagia, PPI). **IV iron** (ferric carboxymaltose, iron sucrose; intolerance, malabsorption, ongoing loss, CKD, pregnancy beyond first trimester; **hypophosphataemia** with FCM, anaphylaxis watched) replenishes fast. Ferritin with transferrin saturation diagnoses; thalassaemia trait (normal RDW, HbA2 high) never irons.
steps.say: Black stools expected on iron: empty stomach vitamin C helps. Hb up 2 in 4 weeks or hunt bleeders.

steps.tx: **B12** (pernicious anti intrinsic factor, vegan, ileal disease; **high dose oral rivals IM** except neuro deficit which injects urgently, lifelong pernicious) with **folate** (pregnancy **4 mg high risk** neural tube, haemolysis demand, methotrexate rescue by **leucovorin**, B12 first as folate alone worsens cords) corrects megaloblastosis; reticulocytosis confirms. **Leucovorin** rescues methotrexate toxicity and 5FU boosts; **levoleucovorin** purifies. Homocysteine with methylmalonic sorts combined lack.
steps.say: Folate alone worsens B12 cords: replace B12 first. High risk pregnancy folate 4 mg; methotrexate needs leucovorin rescue.

steps.tx: **Erythropoietin** (CKD anaemia, chemo anaemia; **Hb target under 11.5** as higher clots and strokes, hypertension watched, iron replete first, **darbepoetin** longer) with **G-CSF** (**filgrastim** neutropenia, bone pain, leukapheresis mobilisation; **pegfilgrastim** single shot) and **GM-CSF** (macrophage, capillary leak) support marrow; **TPO mimetics** (**eltrombopag**, romiplostim: ITP second line, liver watched, rebound thrombocytopenia) raise platelets. Pure red cell aplasia (anti EPO antibodies) stops drug.
steps.say: EPO Hb capped under 11.5 or clots: iron first. Filgrastim aches bones mobilising stem cells.

steps.tx: **Hydroxyurea** (sickle cell raising **HbF**, crises with chest and priapism down, myelosuppression with leg ulcers watched) with **iron chelators** (**deferoxamine** infusion with ocular and auditory toxicity, growth delay; **deferiprone** oral with **agranulocytosis** weekly ANC; **deferasirox** oral with renal Fanconi watched) manages overload (thalassaemia major, ferritin with cardiac T2 star guiding). Luspatercept (thalassaemia, MDS ring sideroblasts) adjuncts; transfusion thresholds individualise.
steps.say: Sickle crises fall as HbF rises on hydroxyurea. Chelate overload: deferoxamine infuses, deferiprone watches counts.
